description: Elections Commissions - Notice that the Supplementary Electoral Register 2024 (1) has been Certified Under the Registration of Electors Act.
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the certification of the Supplementary Electoral Register 2024(1) under the Registration of Electors Act. It provides details about the electoral districts, the officers who certified the register, and the locations where the register can be inspected. The content is specifically about the electoral process and voter registration, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
